info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Etas-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) data for rideshare services. By querying this endpoint, users can obtain up-to-date information regarding the expected arrival times of rideshare vehicles. This API is primarily targeted at developers integrating ride-hailing solutions, enabling applications to offer users accurate travel estimates. Use cases include transportation apps, logistics platforms, and any service requiring timely rideshare updates.

get.description: Fetches the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a ride based on the given parameters. This endpoint helps users to know when their ride is expected to arrive, enhancing their planning and waiting experience.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides. This should include necessary details like pickup and drop-off locations.

200.description: Successfully retrieved estimated time of arrival.

ListRideshareRidesEtasRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to ride ETA requests. It is expected to be a string that can represent various request body data.
